{{Quote|What kind of brain-withered old fool shares wine with his enemy?|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], finding [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] and the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] celebrating with [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="MA" />}}
'''Wine''' was a beverage typically made from [[Grape/Legends|grapes]],<ref name="Void 3">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref> berries,<ref name="TB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]], or [[Grain/Legends|grain]].<ref name="MSII" /><ref name="CN1" /> The process involved fermentation,<ref name="Star Wars 1977 24">[[Star Wars (1977) 24|''Star Wars'' (1977) 24]]</ref> and wine was usually [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]].

==Description==
{{Quote|What now?''"<br />"''You forgot the wine.''"<br />"''Would you prefer white, red, green or purple?''"<br />"''Red.''"<br />"''Dry or wet?''"<br />"''Dry!''"<br />''"Temperature?''".<br />"''Thirty-nine degrees.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] making [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] dinner|<ref name="Court" />}}
Wine was classified among the stronger alcoholic beverages known as [[Spirit (alcohol)|spirits]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref><ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref> Fine wine was valued in many cultures.<ref name="The Monster">{{GamerCite|2|The Monster}}</ref> A fine wine got better with age,<ref name="The Old Republic: Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref><ref name="Void 3" /> and particularly fine wine was aged until it was perfect.<ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> ''Vintage wine'' also denoted quality.<ref name="HTTE" /><ref name="RCHC" /><ref name="MSII" /><ref name="O" /><ref name="D" /><ref name="The Old Republic: Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref> Some people would save a good bottle of wine for an extra special occasion.<ref name="Void 3" />

[[File:AToast-SM.png|thumb|left|260px|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] enjoy some wine.]]
The taste of wine could be described as everything from sweet<ref name="DJ" /><ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref><ref name="Shatterpoint novel">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref> to tart<ref name="MSII" /> to mellow<ref name="RP" /> to dry,<ref name="Court">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> tart, sour<ref name="BW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref> or wet.<ref name="Court" /> Some people liked the taste better if the wine was exposed to air ("letting it breathe"), and would uncork the bottle and let it sit like that for a while before drinking.<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> The liquid could be warmed<ref name="RP" /><ref name="DJ" /> or chilled<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref><ref name="O" /> to reach the perfect temperature and quality, for example thirty-nine degrees.<ref name="Court" /> A wine bottle was sometimes put in a bucket of [[Water/Legends|ice]] before it was opened.<ref name="O" />

''Effervescent wine''<ref name="AC2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref><ref name="DJ" /> made a unique sound when the cork was popped from the bottle.<ref name="AC2" /> ''Sparkling wine'' had bubbles in it.<ref name="O" /> Some types of wine were ''fortified'' with stronger types of alcohol in order to make it more potent.<ref name="Void 3" />

The beverage was often paired with food,<ref name="HTTE" /><ref name="Court" /><ref name="DS" /><ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref><ref name="B">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref><ref name="MF" /> but it could also be enjoyed without it.<ref name="RP" /><ref name="MSII" /><ref name="TB" /><ref name="D" /> Some people liked to have wine with dinner<ref name="DS" /><ref name="B" /> and restaurants<ref name="O" /> and [[Casino/Legends|casinos]]<ref name="Sacrifice" /> often had a wine list for customers to choose from. Some types of wine, like [[Corellian wine/Legends|Corellian wine]]<ref name="II">{{JournalCite|12|Idol Intentions}}</ref> and [[Deltron spice wine]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> were also used as an ingredient in cooking.
[[File:Blossom_Wine.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A servant presenting Blossom wine.]]

People sometimes had wine when celebrating,<ref name="MA" /><ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref><ref name="MSII" /><ref name="O66" /><ref name="O" /> and it was also commonly served at parties,<ref name="EC">{{JournalCite|9|Easy Credits}}</ref><ref name="MA" /> both in formal festivities<ref name="EC" /> and the wilder sort.<ref name="Star Wars: Return of the Jedi novelization">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars: Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novel]]</ref><ref name="MA" />

Wine was usually stored in bottles,<ref name="TB" /><ref name="CS" /><ref name="MSII" /><ref name="MF" /><ref name="O" /><ref name="D" /><ref name="Void 3" /> flasks,<ref name="HT">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref> casks,<ref name="The Great Herdship Heist">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref> cases<ref name="BW" /> or barrels,<ref name="JVS" /> and drunk from a goblet,<ref name="MA" /><ref name="DJ" /><ref name="Eruption">{{InsiderCite|141|Eruption}}</ref> glass<ref name="RP" /><ref name="BW" /><ref name="DJ" /><ref name="MSII" /><ref name="O66" /><ref name="B" /><ref name="MF" /><ref name="Void 3" />(sometimes made from delicate crystal<ref name="CS" />), chalice<ref name="D" /> or cup.<ref name="TB" /><ref name="Blaze of Glory short story">{{JournalCite|8|Blaze of Glory (short story)}}</ref><ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> It was sometimes served in a carafe<ref name="CN1" /> or a decanter.<ref name="BW" /><ref name="D" /> The liquid was usually sipped at, rather than being gulped down.<ref name="HTTE" /><ref name="TB" /><ref name="BW" /><ref name="DJ" /><ref name="MSII" /><ref name="D" /><ref name="Void 3" /> According to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the older a person became, the more they would appreciate excellent wine.<ref name="YDR" />

A plantation grown for winemaking was called a ''vineyard''.<ref name="The Kathol Outback">''[[The Kathol Outback]]''</ref><ref name="D" /> A property where wine was produced was called a ''winery''. A winery featured cultivated [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and wine making equipment, like extraction presses and wooden storage barrels.<ref name="End Game">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref> Some wealthy people had one or more ''wine cellars''&mdash;large storage rooms for wine&mdash;in their home.<ref name="CS" /><ref name="Side Trip">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref><ref name="RCHC" /><ref name="YDR" />

[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref><ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and [[Glova]]<ref name="The Politics of Contraband">''[[The Politics of Contraband]]''</ref> were major exporters of wine, and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roonadan]] had special wine bars.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> [[Haleoda]], the capital city of [[Kattada/Legends|Kattada]], was famous for its fine food and wine.<ref name="EA" /> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] wine had a reputation for being bad.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

[[File:Epguide215.jpg|thumb|left|230px|A glass of wine.]]

The [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] name ''Daini'' referred to wine, drinking [[Water/Legends|water]], or sweet [[Tea/Legends|tea]]. Another Cerean female name, ''[[Naiana]]'', was a type of fruity wine enjoyed on [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]]. ''Mus'' was a name given to female [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]], and meant "wine". This name originally referred to any strong [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] that was used to cleanse wounds.<ref name="Galactic Campaign Guide">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Tamith Kai]] was described as having wine-colored lips,<ref name="The Dark Side Sourcebook">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> and an unnamed [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warrior caste|warrior]] who performed a demonstration the [[bo'tous]] [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] was described as wearing a wine-colored tunic.<ref name="HT" />
